table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode,  
	SaleDetail.AlternateCustomICode,
	itemname= item.name,  
	location = item.location,
	itemtypecode = item.itemtypecode,
	locksaleprice = dbo.item.locksaleprice, 
	lockdiscperc = dbo.item.lockdiscperc, 
	AllowSaleInDecimalQty=dbo.item.AllowSaleInDecimalQty,
	currlistrow = 0, 
	stock     = 0.0000, 
	QuickSearch=SPACE(100),
	itempacking=(SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.Packcode=saledetail.icode),
	packingdesc=
		CASE 
		WHEN SaleDetail.AlternateCustomICode IS NULL OR SaleDetail.AlternateCustomICode = '' THEN item.packingdesc 
		ELSE (SELECT MAX(AIA.PackingDesc) FROM AlternateItemAlias AIA WHERE AIA.ICode=SaleDetail.ICode AND AIA.CustomICode = SaleDetail.AlternateCustomICode) END,
	qtysale=item.saleqty,
	bonus=item.bonusqty,
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	purprice=0.00,
	recentpurprice=0.00,
	avgprice=0.000,
	LatestNetRate=0.00,
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	assgcode  = 1, 
	updatesaleprice = 'N',
	saledetail.saleinvcode,   
	saledetail.icode,   
	saledetail.gcode,
	itemmetercode=saledetail.itemmetercode,
	itemmetername=(SELECT IM.Name FROM ItemMeter IM WHERE IM.itemmetercode=saledetail.itemmetercode),
	meterreading = saledetail.meterreading,
	PreDiscPerc=max(ROUND( (Saledetail.itemflatdisc / CASE WHEN Saledetail.SalePrice > 0 THEN Saledetail.SalePrice ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2)),
	cloneitemflatdisc = max(saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc),
	itemflatdisc = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	Id        = max(saledetail.IDENTITYCOL), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits),
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice),
	clonesaleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice),
	discprice=0.00,
	pricepolicyapplied = 0,
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax), 
	Due       = max(Due),
	SatisfiedDate = max(SatisfiedDate),
	DueQty    = 0.0000,
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty),
	SaleItemDescription =  max( saledetail.SaleItemDescription),
	InsCode =  Max(saledetail.InsCode),
	DescICode =  max( saledetail.DescICode),
	claimable=max(saledetail.claimable),
	claimablediscperc=max(saledetail.claimablediscperc),
	clonediscperc  = max(saledetail.clonediscperc),
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc),
	itemcode = 0,
	rowgroup=saledetail.rowgroup,
	retailprice=item.retailprice,
	saleorderrowid=saledetail.saleorderrowid,
	salerowid=saledetail.salerowid,
	issuerowid=saledetail.issuerowid,
	RefusalSaleRowID = saledetail.RefusalSaleRowID,
	sourcesaleinvcode=saledetail.sourcesaleinvcode,
	packprice = max(saledetail.packprice),
	purunitrate = max(saledetail.purunitrate),
	rppunitrate = max(saledetail.rppunitrate),
	BatchCost = max(saledetail.BatchCost),
	alternatepurprice = max(saledetail.alternatepurprice),
	itemalertcode = item.itemalertcode,
	UnitWeight = item.UnitWeight,
	PackingFactor = item.PackingFactor,
	PackCapacity = item.PackCapacity,
	AreaVolume = item.AreaVolume,
	Width = SaleDetail.Width,
	Length = SaleDetail.Length,
	RatePerLength = Round(max(saledetail.saleprice) / CASE WHEN Item.Length > 0 THEN Item.Length ELSE 1 END, 2),
	PCS=ROUND(sum(saledetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume IS NULL OR item.AreaVolume <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE item.AreaVolume END, 6),
	Cartons= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CAST(((ROUND(sum(saledetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6)) / CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END) AS INT), 7, 0))) + ' : ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(((CAST(ROUND(sum(saledetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6) AS INT)) % CAST(CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END AS INT)), 7, 0))),
	HeaderNo = Item.HeaderNo,
	taxflag = 1,
	unitsalestax=max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc=max(saledetail.gstperc),
	packqtyforsale = Max(saledetail.packqtyforsale) , 
	bonuspackqtyforsale = Max(saledetail.bonuspackqtyforsale),
	PackSalePrice = Max(saledetail.PackSalePrice),
	CommissionPerUnit=Max(saledetail.commissionperunit),
	CommissionPerc=Max(saledetail.commissionperc),
	TotalPieces=sum (saledetail.TotalPieces),
	PiecesInHand=MAX(saledetail.piecesinhand),
	ExtraTaxPerc=max(((((saledetail.looseqty +saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax)  * 100) / CASE WHEN (SaleDetail.LooseQty * (SaleDetail.SalePrice -  SaleDetail.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SaleDetail.DiscPerc * 0.01)) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 	(SaleDetail.LooseQty * (SaleDetail.SalePrice -  SaleDetail.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SaleDetail.DiscPerc * 0.01)) END)),
	MyRowID = 0,
	YourLotNo = MAX(saledetail.YourLotNo),
	YourExpiry = MAX(saledetail.YourExpiry),
	YourPacking = MAX(saledetail.YourPacking),
	SaleTypeCode=1,
	SaleCatCode=1,
	Taxable = Item.Taxable,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc = MAX(SaleDetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc),
	bonusqty=sum (saledetail.bonusqty),
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty) 

FROM 
	saledetail, 
	item 

WHERE 
	( dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )    AND
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
         
GROUP BY 
	saledetail.saleinvcode, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.RowGroup,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	saledetail.itemmetercode,
	saledetail.meterreading,
	saledetail.saleorderrowid,
	saledetail.salerowid,
	saledetail.issuerowid,
	saledetail.RefusalSaleRowID,
	saledetail.sourcesaleinvcode,
	item.customicode, 
	SaleDetail.AlternateCustomICode,
	item.saleqty, 
	item.bonusqty, 
	item.name,
	item.location,
	item.itemtypecode,
	item.itemalertcode,
	item.UnitWeight,
	item.PackingFactor,
	item.locksaleprice,
	item.lockdiscperc,
	item.AllowSaleInDecimalQty,
	item.retailprice,
	item.PackCapacity,
	item.AreaVolume,
	item.taxable,
	SaleDetail.Width,
	SaleDetail.Length,
	item.Length,
	item.packingdesc,
	Item.HeaderNo

ORDER BY 
	MIN(saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum((  ( looseqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc ))  +   ( packqty * (saleprice -  itemflatdisc )  * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )  for all)

objects.name: c_sumtaxval
objects.expression: sum( round( unitsalestax  * (Bonusqty + looseqty) ,2)  for all)

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: sum( round( c_itemtotal  *  gstperc * 0.01,2)  for all)

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: sum( unitweight * ( looseqty + bonusqty ) for all)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum( packingfactor * ( looseqty + bonusqty ) for all)

objects.name: c_totaldiscount
objects.expression: sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + if(rate - saleprice > 0, sum(looseqty * (rate - saleprice) for all), 0) + sum( round(((saleprice - itemflatdisc)*discperc*0.01)*looseqty,2) for all)

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: trim(string(sum(long(left(cartons, pos( cartons , ':', 1) - 1))))) + ' : ' + trim(string(sum(long(mid(cartons, pos( cartons , ':', 1) + 1, len(cartons))))))

objects.name: c_tot_discperc_value
objects.expression: sum((if(cloneitemflatdisc > 0 OR clonediscperc > 0,rate, saleprice) - if(itemflatdisc > 0, itemflatdisc, cloneitemflatdisc)) * looseqty * if(discperc > 0, discperc, clonediscperc) * 0.01 for all)

objects.name: c_tot_itemdiscount
objects.expression: sum((saleprice - itemflatdisc) * looseqty * discperc * 0.01 for all) + sum( itemflatdisc * looseqty for all)

objects.name: c_itemtotal
objects.expression: (  ( looseqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc ))  +   ( packqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc ) * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )

objects.name: c_discperc_value
objects.expression: (if(cloneitemflatdisc > 0 OR clonediscperc > 0,rate, saleprice) - if(itemflatdisc > 0, itemflatdisc, cloneitemflatdisc)) * looseqty * if(discperc > 0, discperc, clonediscperc) * 0.01

objects.name: c_new_discperc
objects.expression: if( c_rsum >= 5000, 10, if(c_rsum >= 1000 and c_rsum < 5000, if(salecatcode = 2, 5.00, 7.50), if(saletypecode <> 3, if(salecatcode=2, 0, 5), 0)))
